card.name: Food portion amounts in diet lists
card.fires_on: Numbers (or the opening parenthesis before them) giving a food quantity in a diet list, such as grams of protein, ounces or packets. Also a space before a number in a range.

modes.label: Portion number
modes.description: The digit that starts an amount of food or protein inside parentheses.
modes.example: Four ounces tofu (<<1>>1 gms of protein) and firm

modes.label: Parenthesis before amount
modes.description: The opening parenthesis right after a food name, just before its amount.
modes.example: One cup of cooked soybeans<< (>>29 gms of protein), lent

modes.label: Space before range number
modes.description: A space just before the second number of a range of quantities or temperatures.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a number for a food serving or amount is about to appear in a diet list.
